cards.card_text: Follow Me and let the dead bury their own dead Go bury your father and then return to Me Stay with your family until the mourning ends
cards.verse_text: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

cards.card_text: Jesus answers the man who wants to bury his father first, “Let the dead bury their own dead.” Then what does Jesus tell this man to go and do?
cards.verse_text: But Jesus told him, “Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”
